transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I suppose... well, things haven't been great. Since my wife's fall, I just... I don't know. I've always been the man with the lists and the plan, you know? Now I just find myself sitting at the kitchen table staring at her medication chart. 

I'm snapping over nothing, or... getting overly emotional. Letting the bills and my mentoring calls just pile up. Even basic housework. I just... I can't seem to make myself function right now.
Are you still enjoying activities that you used to find pleasurable?
I'm not really sure. I haven't... I haven't really tried to do much of anything lately. I just don't have the inclination.
Do you feel guilty about anything related to your wife's fall?
Guilty? ...No. I don't think so. It was an accident. I... I don't see why I would feel guilty about it.
Have you been feeling sad most of the time since your wife's fall?
Sad? ... I don't really know. I wouldn't say I'm sad, exactly. I just... haven't really thought about it like that.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing that you no longer find enjoyable?
I think... I think you just asked me that. Like I said, I haven't really been doing much lately. So I couldn't tell you.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure right now?
Pleasure? I... I don't know. I'm just getting through the days. I'm not really looking for... pleasure right now.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?
Weight? ... No, I don't think so. I haven't really been paying attention to that.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
Anxious? Um... I suppose not really. Just... tired, mostly. Nothing like that.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself?
No. ... No, I haven't had any thoughts like that.
Are there things you used to think about or look forward to that now seem uninteresting or unimportant to you?
Unimportant? ... No, I don't think so. I just... do what I usually do. I haven't really noticed a change like that.
Do you feel like you're unable to enjoy things that normally would bring you happiness?
No... I don't think so. I still enjoy my day-to-day things just fine, I suppose. Nothing has really changed there.
Do you feel tired most of the time?
No, not especially. ... My energy level is fine, I suppose.
Do you often think you're to blame for things that go wrong?
No, not really. ... If something goes wrong, it just goes wrong. I don't sit around blaming myself for it.
Are there activities that you used to do regularly that you have stopped doing since your wife's fall?

I suppose... yes. I used to do some mentoring, help out in the community a bit. I haven't been going to that. And... well, just things around the house. Paying the bills, keeping the place up. I used to just do them, but lately... I guess things are slipping a bit.
Do you feel like you're feeling emotions less intensely than you used to?
No... I wouldn't say that. I still feel things about the same, I suppose. I haven't really noticed a difference there.
How long have you been feeling this way since your wife's fall?
It's been... about two months. Ever since the fall. Everything just... changed after that.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt depressed most of the day?
I don't know if I'd use that word. Depressed. I wouldn't say it's been like that. It's just... a lot to manage right now. But no, I don't think so.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt depressed most of the day?
I... I believe I just answered that. No. Like I said, I wouldn't use that word. It's just... a lot to handle right now. That's all.
Do you feel like you've been consistently feeling down or empty inside since your wife's fall?
I... no. Not empty. Like I was saying, I'm just busy trying to keep up with everything now. It's just tiring, that's all. I wouldn't say empty.
Have you noticed a decrease in interest in activities you used to enjoy since your wife's fall?
I wouldn't say that. I still enjoy the same things. I just... I don't have a lot of free time for them at the moment. That's really it.
